title: Chapter 1281
text:
"Oh? You're saying that someone is hunting Beyond Grade A seeds? "

In the exclusive machinery factory of Black Star Palace, Han Xiao turned to look at the virtual communication screen and looked at Fu Ding in surprise.

He had been busy digesting the technology recently. Just a moment ago, Fu Ding suddenly called and said that he had captured a hunting team that specialized in attacking Beyond Grade A seeds.

"Tell me in detail. I want to know all the details." Han Xiao put down the parts in his hands and said with a serious expression.

"It's like this …" Fu Ding nodded and explained the process in detail.

After capturing these attackers, through interrogation and reading their memories, he managed to dig out shocking information. These Calamity Grades who attacked Kevin were all acting under orders. They had secretly taken control of this galactic pirate gang and had been loitering nearby, waiting to intercept and kill Kevin.

"Do you know which organization they belong to?" Han Xiao was curious.

Fu Ding shook his head. "I've checked. These Calamity Grades did not leave any information about their identities in the universe. At the same time, they do not have any relevant memories and do not know which organization they are working for. They only accept direct orders from one account, and the account that gives out missions to each of them is different. I carefully checked their memories and found that they have been receiving some kind of thought shaping training since they were young. They seem to be specially trained warriors of death, and their self-awareness is extremely weak. "

"Secret warriors of death without any records? An organization that can train eight Calamity Grades as warriors of death from a young age is not some small organization. Furthermore, the so-called thought shaping training should be some kind of brainwashing method that can maintain long-term effects on Calamity Grades. It has to be at least a Star Cluster level technology. "

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows, pondered for a while, and said,

"Are there any other clues?"

"I've found some safe houses and secret codes, as well as the past deeds of these people. Wait for me to compile a report and give it to you. I'll send you the top secret accounts of these people later. It might be useful to you."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "Since you're taking this matter so seriously, it seems that you've also realized the problem?"

Fu Ding sighed. "If I couldn't guess the severity of the matter, I wouldn't have informed you immediately … There aren't many organizations that can nurture multiple Calamity Grade Deathguards, and this team might not be the only hunter team. Coupled with the recent Sanctum Revival storm, the situation is obviously not simple."

"That's right. There are very few organizations with the motive and ability to do such a thing. The three Universal Civilizations and the Supercluster Alliance are all suspects."

Han Xiao nodded.

Although Han Xiao did not ask about their origins, through various factors, the first thing that came to his mind was the three Universal Civilizations and the Supercluster Alliance. Both of them had motives.

The former might be trying to reduce the number of new Beyond Grade As in the future, secretly reducing the source of new Beyond Grade As. The latter had many motives. It was possible to create opposition and force the three Universal Civilizations to shed all pretense of cordiality with the association.

Of course, he did not rule out the possibility of others taking advantage of the situation, so Han Xiao did not immediately come to a conclusion. However, he was still inclined to believe that this was a secret operation of the three Universal Civilizations or the Supercluster.

From this, it was likely that there was more than one hunter team. Currently, there were many Beyond Grade A seeds in the various Star Fields rushing to the Flickering World, and the mastermind behind the scenes had likely arranged an interception team. These Beyond Grade A seeds were all in danger, and not everyone was lucky enough to meet the number one healer of the universe.

Fu Ding frowned and asked in confusion, "Let's not talk about the Supercluster, but the three Universal Civilizations … could it really be them? I find it unbelievable. Aren't they afraid of pushing all the neutral high-level Supers to the opposite side by carrying out such a crazy plan? This is too radical, not like the methods they would use. "

Han Xiao shook his head and said, "This is a crazy method.

There are only so many Beyond Grade A seeds in the entire universe, so the cost of doing this is not high. Even if all these people go missing, the impact can be easily suppressed.

Furthermore, the three Universal Civilizations should be very clear that they have lost the monopoly advantage of the Ultimate Knowledge. We can give them what they can, but we have the attraction of the Sanctum Revival, which makes it difficult for them to recruit new talents. Therefore, they don't even need to push. Many Beyond Grade A seeds will join the association anyway. If they do nothing, the situation will only get worse. Instead of watching the association's talent pool continue to grow, they might as well secretly send men of sacrifice to capture and kill people. If they can't get them, they can just destroy them. This is probably what they are thinking.

As for the radical methods … the Tragedy of the Pinnacles is also radical. The three Universal Civilizations have never been kind people, so don't misunderstand them. Which of the victors of the exploration era is not ruthless? Once provoked, they can do anything. "

Fu Ding pursed his lips. "Aren't they afraid of being exposed?"

Han Xiao stroked his chin. "I think they are, but it will depend on how the three Universal Civilizations operate. It's hard to say now."

In his previous life, there was no association or Sanctum Revival, so the conflicts were different. Therefore, the Beyond Grade A seeds were not intercepted. This was the first time Han Xiao had encountered such a situation. The three Universal Civilizations' actions were also unknown to him.

With the Beyond Grade A seeds being unlucky, Han Xiao could do nothing about it. He could only treat it as the fish in the moat.

"The scope of this storm is getting bigger and bigger." Fu Ding looked worried. "What do you plan to do?"

"Hmm, the association's purpose is to mediate the conflicts between the Beyond Grade As. The Calamity Grade is not within our scope of responsibility. Therefore, in name, the association can't cross the line and provide help publicly, unless we really want to fight head-on …"

Han Xiao stroked his chin and pondered.

"However, if we don't stop it, the Beyond Grade A seeds will suffer heavy casualties, which is indeed not conducive to the birth of new people. How about this? Don't they want to join different Beyond Grade A organizations? Then, the corresponding organizations will secretly send people to escort them. This will make sense in name. "

"Alright." Fu Ding paused for a moment before asking, "However, this will result in a battle with the hunting teams. Should we spread the news and alert the Beyond Grade A seeds, as well as give the mastermind a warning?"

Han Xiao thought about it and shook his head.

"It's enough to hint to the Beyond Grade A seeds privately. Don't spread this news on a large scale … Now that it's exposed, the Supercluster Alliance will be the happiest. I don't want to fall out with the three Universal Civilizations yet, nor do I want to be used by the Supercluster. Let's prioritize protection first and avoid conflict for the time being. "

Although he had the Sanctum Revival in name, the Holy Covenant Organization had yet to collect the second set of keys, so Han Xiao's confidence was still a little weak for the time being. Causing trouble was not within his consideration, so he had to be more stable.

"Understood. What else do I have to do?" Fu Ding asked.

"You guys … look for the nearby Beyond Grade A seeds. They'll be safer with Aurora. Just bring them back when the time comes."

As he said that, Han Xiao smiled with relief.

"You've made a great contribution this time. If not for your news, we might have only noticed that something was wrong when the Beyond Grade A seeds disappeared on a large scale. Lending you to Aurora back then was the right decision!"

He felt that Feidin was a perfect intelligence agent. Most people were looking for trouble, but Feidin was looking for trouble. He could find key information while lying down, and it was fully automatic. There was no need to worry at all.

Fu Ding, you're so useful!

Fu Ding had a helpless look on his face. He had already accepted his position as a tool.

"By the way, what about these captives after I'm done interrogating them? They might be witnesses if we keep them. "

"What else can we do? The Underworld will serve them."

Han Xiao waved his hands nonchalantly.

You have triggered the mission [Stop the Hunt]!

Mission Introduction: For some reason, some unknown forces are trying to hunt down the talents who want to join you. As a reputable organization, protecting the safety of the candidates is a basic requirement.

Mission Objective: Stop the hunt on the Beyond Grade A seeds as much as possible.

Remarks: Reward depends on the Mission Rating. The Mission Rating depends on the number of people you successfully rescue.

Basic Reward: 800,000,000 EXP, + 20 Favorability of the rescued target, x2 Random Rewards, and x1 Blank Character Summon Card.

"The EXP is a little low, but the Blank Character Summon Card is not bad."

Han Xiao glanced at the interface before putting it away. A mission of this level could not affect his mood at all. Currently, he was more concerned about the matter itself.

"The three Universal Civilizations' reaction is not small. Peaceful coexistence is really an extravagant hope. They can always cause trouble … It's been almost fifty years since the version update, and the players should be coming back soon. When that time comes, there'll probably be another wave of explosions."

Han Xiao rubbed his brows. Suddenly, he thought of something.

"By the way, someone is hunting the Beyond Grade A seeds. This is also a chance for me to poach people. I wonder how Carrott is doing now. He's at most an ordinary Calamity Grade, so he shouldn't be taken seriously. I might as well just knock him out and poach him over."

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat.

In the past, he did not poach Carrott because he did not want to interfere with the other party's growth. Now that someone was targeting a neutral Beyond Grade A seed, he could not be blamed for doing the same.

Originally, Carrott would have become the National Pillar of the dynasty's direct descendants, but now that you've done the same, I'm going to kill this guy!

Unlike the mastermind's wide net, Han Xiao knew exactly who some of the direct Beyond Grade As of the advanced civilizations were. In the past, he could not poach them due to various reasons, but now, there was no need to talk about it.

Furthermore, Han Xiao was also worried that the huge changes in the storyline would cause someone like Carrott, who would shine in the future, to die young. If that happened, the losses would outweigh the gains. He might as well end the breeding and gather all of them to ensure that they would not die prematurely.

"If they know the truth, they'll have to thank me. For the peace of the universe, I've really broken my heart. Maybe this is what it means to have boundless love. Even I admire myself. How can there be such a great man in this world …"

Han Xiao almost touched himself. He felt that his skin had become thicker.
